caption: The drawing shows a metallic, dark gray vessel with an ornate, swirling pattern encircling the body, sitting on a matching round tray. The vessel features a single, curved handle and an open top. Two yellow cylindrical objects are upright inside the vessel, one of which is capped with a small cup-like cover attached to a chain that connects back to the vessel. The composition is centered in a square and bordered by a faint red outline. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a rectangular decorative design featuring symmetrical, scrolling lines. In the lower right corner, a small technical sketch shows the same vessel from the side, complete with dimensions indicated by arrows. The background is a light, off-white color with some aged spots visible.
title: Lamp
